instruction: My roommate requested me to pay for my share of the housing bill this month on venmo today. But they forgot about the 5% rent increase starting this month. So reject that payment request and send them the corrected amount of money with a note, "You forgot about the 5% increase!".
notes: The roommate is identified via phone.search_contacts (relationship=roommate), which yields their email; venmo.show_received_payment_requests then exposes the housing request id and its amount. The 5% rent increase is encoded as the static fact (increased-by-5-percent amount-original amount-corrected) with amount-corrected computed at runtime as 1.05x the requested amount. The goal requires the request to be denied (only denied_at changes) and exactly one transaction sent to the roommate with the corrected amount and the exact note; the transaction uses Venmo balance (no payment card). supervisor.complete_task takes no answer since the task is not a question.

plan: (venmo-create-transaction roommate-email amount-corrected venmo-token note-you-forgot-about-the-5-percent-increase roommate housing-request amount-original)
